page.notes: Index of a 16th-century Latin book, probably the Scripturarum/Spiritus index. The printed text is set in three columns, one printed page on the scan. Some entries are marked with a degraded or doubtful letter (e.g. "Scortatio ... fugieda", "Spiritussanctus" where the long s form appears as s in the scan; the "s" has been rendered as s). Several words in the first column are slightly blurred and given as printed; a few numerals in the right column are uncertain.
